transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I keep getting pulled off track really easily. Like, I’ll be trying to finish a dashboard, and then a Slack ping or even a song lyric or some random idea comes up, and I’ve completely lost what I was doing.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

Yeah… sometimes. If I’m stuck sitting through a long Zoom call or trying to work quietly in one spot, I get this kind of uncomfortable pressure, like I need to get up or pace or at least do something with my hands.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

Yeah… sometimes. Like in group brainstorming, I’ll kind of jump in before someone’s finished explaining, or I’ll start adding something to the Figma board too fast. I don’t mean to be pushy, I just get excited, but afterward I realize it probably came off that way.
Do you have trouble focusing or following through on instructions at work, at home, or in other areas of your life?

Yeah… I do. If someone gives me, like, a list of revisions, I’ll usually do the first couple right away, and then I sort of… end up redesigning something else. And then one small thing that actually mattered gets left unfinished.
Have you always had trouble with focus and impulsivity, or is this something that started more recently?

I think it’s been there for a long time. Even in elementary school, teachers would write stuff like I rushed through worksheets or didn’t keep track of the directions. I guess I also talked over people in group work. My parents had to sit with me during homework because I’d wander off or start something else before finishing.
Has your difficulty with focus and impulsivity caused any significant problems in your relationships or at work?

Yeah… it has, a bit. I’ve lost some small freelance stuff because I didn’t follow through cleanly, and I missed out on a portfolio competition for kind of the same reason. People still like my ideas, I think, but some friends or collaborators are… more hesitant to work with me now.
As a child, did you often have trouble playing quietly or engaging in leisure activities?

Yeah, kind of. Quiet things didn’t really stay quiet for me. Like even if I was reading or sketching, I’d start talking to myself, put music on, check something, or turn it into some bigger thing instead of just… doing it calmly.
Did you often run, climb, or be physically active to the point where it was difficult for you to stop as a child?

I don’t remember it as like… constant running or climbing exactly. More that sitting still was hard. Even now, if I’m stuck on a long Zoom call or trying to work quietly in one place, I get this uncomfortable restless feeling, like I need to get up or pace or at least do something with my hands.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus or following through on tasks in multiple areas of your life, such as both at work and at home?

Yeah… it’s shown up in more than one place. Mostly with freelance work and art stuff — I’ve lost a couple small contracts and missed a portfolio competition because I didn’t follow through well enough. And… socially too, I guess. Some friends or collaborators are more cautious about working with me now, even if they like the ideas.
Have you experienced these difficulties with focus and impulsivity in settings beyond work and home, such as in school or in social situations with friends?

Yeah… mostly socially, I guess. Like with friends or people I might collaborate with. I’ve missed out on some opportunities, like small freelance things and a portfolio competition, because I didn’t follow through cleanly enough. And now some people are kind of hesitant to work with me, even if they like my ideas.
Have you ever gotten into trouble at work, school, or in your personal life because of acting on impulse?

Yeah… not like major trouble, but I’ve definitely made things awkward. In brainstorming, I’ll sometimes blurt out an idea before someone’s finished, or start adding to their Figma board too soon. Afterward I realize I probably came off kind of pushy, even if I was just excited.
Do you think your difficulties with focus and impulsivity are causing significant problems in your daily life?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not like my whole life is falling apart, but I’ve lost a couple small freelance things and missed a portfolio competition because I wasn’t reliable enough with follow-through. And some friends or collaborators are more hesitant to work with me now, even if they like my ideas.
Have your difficulties with focus and impulsivity led to any significant problems in your romantic relationships?
Um… I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed anything major there, or I guess I don’t really have much to say about that.
Would you say that your difficulties with focus and impulsivity are mild, moderate, or severe?

I’d say mild, probably. It has caused issues, like losing small freelance opportunities and missing a portfolio competition because I didn’t follow through cleanly. And some friends or collaborators are a bit hesitant now… but it’s not like everything is falling apart.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus and impulsivity in all of the settings where you've spent time, such as school, work, home, and social situations, for as long as you can remember?

Yeah… I think it’s been there for a long time. Like, even in elementary school, teachers would write that I rushed through worksheets or didn’t follow directions all the way. I’d talk over people in group stuff too.

At home my parents had to sit with me during homework, because I’d kind of drift off or start doing something else before finishing. So… yeah, it wasn’t just recent.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you didn't experience these difficulties with focus and impulsivity?

I mean… not really completely. It’s felt more like it started causing actual problems around a year and five months ago, when I moved out of structured school projects and started trying to build my freelance UX and data-visualization portfolio. Before that, the structure kind of hid it more, I guess.
Have your difficulties with focus and impulsivity caused problems in your friendships or other relationships outside of work?

Yeah… a bit. Some friends and people I’ve collaborated with are kind of hesitant to work with me now, I think. They still like my ideas, but I’ve missed follow-through enough that they don’t fully rely on me. And I’ve lost a couple small freelance things because of that too.
Have you ever had a comprehensive evaluation for Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)?
No… I don’t think I’ve ever had a full evaluation for it. Not formally, anyway.
Have you experienced any significant strain in your relationships with family members because of your difficulties with focus and impulsivity?
Um… not really significant, I don’t think. Maybe some frustration sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it causing a big strain with my family.
Have you ever had symptoms of inattention, hyperactivity, or impulsivity that were severe enough to cause significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other areas of life?

Yeah… I think so. It’s not like everything fell apart, but I have lost some small freelance contracts, and I missed out on a portfolio competition because I didn’t follow through cleanly. Some friends and collaborators are kind of hesitant to work with me now, even if they still like my ideas.
